newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: African Dev Bank in debut S.African operation.
newsitem.headline: African Dev Bank in debut S.African operation.

text.p: The African Development Bank said it was investing around $25 million in the Johannesburg-based South Africa Infrastructre Fund (SAIF), its first operation of any kind in South Africa.
The participation, accounting for 11 percent of what is expected to be a $221 million fund, will be made through the Abidjan-based AfDB's private sector window.
The Fund will invest in water supply, sewerage, energy, telecommunications and energy projects in South Africa and other countries of the Southern African Development Community.
The AfDB said SAIF is promoted by Standard Bank of South Africa, part of the Standard Bank Investment Corporation (STANBIC).
It said the operation was approved after "intense negotiations that began a long time ago between the Bank, government authorities and the South African business community".

"At present, the Bank is studying other prospects, such as the possibility of granting lines of credit to South African financial institutions," the AfDB said, adding this would allow it to contribute to the development of several sectors of the economy.
